title: http_failure() puts up to 300 bytes of the upstream provider's response body into the NETWORK_ERROR detail string (backend.rs:255-260)
description: http_failure() puts up to 300 bytes of the upstream provider's response body into the NETWORK_ERROR detail string (backend.rs:255-260). That string is returned to callers and is typically logged. Provider error bodies can echo request content, and the request carries the canonical payload and evaluator prompt. The Jev backend does not do this: its non-200 path returns only 'HTTP {status}' (sc-jev/src/client/mod.rs:217-221). The two backends therefore apply different error-redaction rules.
